title: 第2413章 未来的自己第2412章 城主指派任务
content_zh:
“先回去修行吧，距离你们下位主神进入遗迹，还有二十五年时间。”
关鸿最后说道：“不管你们能否找到始源天龙，回来之后都会给你奖励。”
“如若前两批能将遗迹探索完，或许就不用你们这些下位主神进去了。”
此次探索的人，共三批，分别是下位主神、中位主神和上位主神。
每个境界选出十个人。
先派出修为最高的上位主神，然后是中位主神，最后是下位主神。
每个境界探索十年，五年后开始。
也就是说，江平安二十五年后才要去执行任务。
听到还有时间，江平安微微松了口气。
趁着这段时间，必须好好提升实力。
“回去吧，等通知，以后遇到什么困难，可以联系城主府。”
关鸿不太喜欢与江平安接触太长时间。
“是，城主大人。”
江平安行礼后解除投影，从原地消失。
修炼室内，江平安的本体叹了口气。
本来，他想修炼结束后，随便接一个任务的。
没想到高层会指派给他这么一个困难任务。
始源天龙能够被上面重视，一定很不一般，他们这些低阶主神进入其中，绝对十分危险。
如果能够拒绝，他肯定拒绝。
奈何他根本没有选择的权利。

事已至此，抱怨都没用了。
“必须在二十五年内，学会《未来经》第一层，增加个保命的手段。”
江平安深吸一口气，屏气凝神，全神贯注地投入到参悟《未来经》中。
没有师尊的他，一切都只能自己摸索。
即便他悟性足够高，也有《时间神纹基础大全》辅助，可在解析《未来经》的时候，还是遇到了很多困难。
《未来经》中的很多神纹，完全不是主神能够参悟的。
甚至很可能是虚神境强者创造的。
江平安甚至开始怀疑，这门《未来经》到底是不是这个主修体魄的星云宫创造的。
为了弄懂第一层中复杂难懂的神纹，他把这些神纹单独摘出来，去专门解析神纹的店铺，花钱解析神纹。
在神墟圣地，有各种各样的店铺。
其中，就有辅助人破解阵法神纹和解析功法的店铺。
店铺会根据需要解析的神纹，进行报价。
这类店铺非常受欢迎，很多在参悟功法神术的过程中，遇到困难，就会寻找这类店铺帮忙，能节省不少时间。
当然，解析归解析，能不能悟透，还要看个人。
很多功法内容都是公开的，但能学会理解的人，并不多。
这个就需要悟性了，也就是人们常说的天份。
《未来经》中的神纹，极为复杂。
江平安把一些参悟不透的神纹，交给店铺帮忙解析。
对方报价一个神纹就要几个亿，最难的那枚神纹，甚至报价七十多亿圣地币。
据店铺方面称，有些神纹需要几个虚神境强者一起拆解才能解析出来。

为了能够了解这些神纹，江平安只能同意店铺的报价。
他身上的圣地币疯狂锐减。
短短几年时间，他在百城体修大战赚到的三百亿，外加城主奖励的一百亿，就慢慢见底了。
为了凑到更多钱，他只能卖掉两节真神课程，换到了两百二十亿。
content_en:
"Go back to practice first. There are still twenty-five years before your next Lord God enters the ruins."
Guan Hong finally said: "No matter whether you can find Shiyuan Tianlong or not, I will give you a reward when you come back."
"If the first two batches can complete the exploration of the ruins, there may not be a need for lower gods like you to go in."
There are three groups of people exploring this time, namely the lower main god, the middle main god and the upper main god.
Select ten people from each realm.
The upper main god with the highest cultivation level is sent first, then the middle main god, and finally the lower main god.
Each realm is explored for ten years, starting after five years.
In other words, Jiang Pingan will go on a mission twenty-five years later.
Jiang Ping'an breathed a sigh of relief when he heard that there was still time.
You must take advantage of this period of time to improve your strength.
"Go back and wait for notification. If you encounter any difficulties in the future, you can contact the City Lord's Mansion."
Guan Hong doesn't like to be in contact with Jiang Ping'an for too long.
"Yes, Lord City Lord."
After Jiang Pingan saluted, he released the projection and disappeared from the place.
In the training room, Jiang Pingan's true form sighed.
Originally, he wanted to take on any random mission after training.
He didn't expect that the higher-ups would assign him such a difficult task.
It must be extraordinary for Shiyuan Tianlong to be taken seriously by the superiors. It is absolutely dangerous for low-level gods like them to enter it.
If he could refuse, he would definitely refuse.
However, he had no choice at all.
The matter has come to this, and there is no point in complaining.
"You must learn the first level of the Future Sutra within twenty-five years and add a means to save your life."
Jiang Ping'an took a deep breath, held his breath and concentrated on concentrating on the "Future Sutra".
Without a master, he can only explore everything by himself.
Even if his understanding was high enough and he was assisted by the "Basic Encyclopedia of Time Patterns", he still encountered many difficulties when analyzing the "Future Sutra".
Many of the divine patterns in the "Future Sutra" cannot be comprehended by the Lord God at all.
It is even possible that it was created by a strong person in the False God Realm.
Jiang Ping'an even began to wonder whether this "Future Sutra" was created by the Nebula Palace who majored in physical fitness.
In order to understand the complex and difficult divine patterns in the first layer, he picked out these divine patterns individually and went to a shop that specialized in analyzing divine patterns to spend money to analyze the divine patterns.
In the Holy Land of Shenxu, there are various shops.
Among them, there are shops that help people decipher the divine patterns of formations and analyze techniques.
The store will make a quotation based on the divine patterns that need to be analyzed.
This type of shop is very popular. Many people who encounter difficulties in the process of understanding the martial arts and magic will seek help from this type of shop, which can save a lot of time.
Of course, analysis is analysis. Whether you can understand it thoroughly depends on the individual.
Many of the contents of the exercises are made public, but not many people can learn to understand them.
This requires understanding, which is what people often call talent.
The divine patterns in the "Future Sutra" are extremely complex.
Jiang Ping'an gave some divine patterns that were difficult to understand to the shop to help analyze them.
The other party quoted a price of several hundred million for each divine symbol. The most difficult divine symbol even quoted more than seven billion holy land coins.
According to the store, some divine patterns require several virtual god realm experts to dismantle them together before they can be analyzed.
In order to understand these divine patterns, Jiang Ping'an could only agree to the store's quotation.
The Holy Land coins on him dropped drastically.
In just a few years, the 30 billion he earned from the Hundred Cities Physical Training War, plus the 10 billion rewarded by the city lord, slowly bottomed out.
In order to collect more money, he could only sell two True God courses and exchange them for 22 billion.
